title: Singular/Plural Nouns - Regular plurals and common irregulars

options.answer: I have two dog.
I have two dogs.
I have two doges.

explanation.en: Regular plural nouns add -s to the singular form.
explanation.ru: Регулярные формы множественного числа образуются добавлением -s к форме единственного числа.
explanation.uz: Oddiy ko‘plik shakllari birlik shakliga -s qo‘shimchasi qo‘shish orqali hosil qilinadi.

options.answer: There are many childs in the park.
There are many childrens in the park.
There are many children in the park.

explanation.en: Child has an irregular plural form: children.
explanation.ru: Слово 'child' имеет неправильную форму множественного числа: 'children'.
explanation.uz: 'child' so‘zining ko‘plik shakli noturg‘un: 'children'.

options.answer: She has three boxs on the table.
She has three boxes on the table.
She has three box on the table.

explanation.en: Nouns ending in -x add -es to form the plural.
explanation.ru: Существительные на -x образуют множественное число с помощью -es.
explanation.uz: -x bilan tugaydigan otlar ko‘plikda -es qo‘shimchasini oladi.

options.answer: The mans are walking in the street.
The men are walking in the street.
The mens are walking in the street.

explanation.en: Man has an irregular plural form: men.
explanation.ru: Слово 'man' имеет неправильную форму множественного числа: 'men'.
explanation.uz: 'man' so‘zining ko‘plik shakli noturg‘un: 'men'.

options.answer: I need to buy some tomatos.
I need to buy some tomatoes.
I need to buy some tomato.

explanation.en: Nouns ending in -o usually add -es to form the plural.
explanation.ru: Существительные на -o обычно образуют множественное число с помощью -es.
explanation.uz: -o bilan tugaydigan otlar odatda ko‘plikda -es qo‘shimchasini oladi.

options.answer: There are many mouses in the house.
There are many mice in the house.
There are many mouse in the house.

explanation.en: Mouse has an irregular plural form: mice.
explanation.ru: Слово 'mouse' имеет неправильную форму множественного числа: 'mice'.
explanation.uz: 'mouse' so‘zining ko‘plik shakli noturg‘un: 'mice'.

options.answer: The leafs are falling from the tree.
The leaves are falling from the tree.
The leaf are falling from the tree.

explanation.en: Nouns ending in -f change to -ves in the plural.
explanation.ru: Существительные на -f в множественном числе меняют -f на -ves.
explanation.uz: -f bilan tugaydigan otlar ko‘plikda odatda -ves ga o‘zgaradi.

options.answer: She has many dresses in her closet.
She has many dress in her closet.
She has many dresss in her closet.

explanation.en: Nouns ending in -ss add -es to form the plural.
explanation.ru: Существительные на -ss образуют множественное число с помощью -es.
explanation.uz: -ss bilan tugaydigan otlar ko‘plikda -es qo‘shimchasini oladi.

options.answer: The womans are talking loudly.
The women are talking loudly.
The womens are talking loudly.

explanation.en: Woman has an irregular plural form: women.
explanation.ru: Слово 'woman' имеет неправильную форму множественного числа: 'women'.
explanation.uz: 'woman' so‘zining ko‘plik shakli noturg‘un: 'women'.

options.answer: I saw three deers in the forest.
I saw three deer in the forest.
I saw three deres in the forest.

explanation.en: Deer has the same form for singular and plural.
explanation.ru: Слово 'deer' имеет одинаковую форму в единственном и множественном числе.
explanation.uz: 'deer' so‘zi birlik va ko‘plikda bir xil shaklga ega.

prompt.en: Write the plural form of the word 'cat'.

options.answer: cats

explanation.en: Regular plural: cat + s = cats.
explanation.ru: Обычная форма множественного числа: cat + s = cats.
explanation.uz: Oddiy ko‘plik: cat + s = cats.

prompt.en: Write the plural form of the word 'foot'.

options.answer: feet

explanation.en: Irregular plural: foot becomes feet.
explanation.ru: Неправильная форма множественного числа: foot → feet.
explanation.uz: Noturg‘un ko‘plik: foot → feet.

prompt.en: Write the plural form of the word 'baby'.

options.answer: babies

explanation.en: Nouns ending in consonant + y change y to i and add -es.
explanation.ru: Если слово оканчивается на согласную + y, y меняется на i и добавляется -es.
explanation.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan otlarda y → i bo‘lib, -es qo‘shiladi.
